_metadata.description: Ship non-git artifacts (built installers, large fixtures) to a node via device-sync-hub directed delivery; never reinvent transport.

requirements.title: Build-Artifact Distribution via device-sync-hub
requirements.description: When a job needs a non-git artifact on a node (a built desktop installer, a large fixture), bridge ships it through device-sync-hub's directed delivery rather than reinventing file transport — 'bridge orchestrates, device-sync-hub moves the bytes.'

validation.notes: Artifact distribution delegates to a device-sync-hub directed-delivery seam; bridge implements no byte-transport of its own.
An installer artifact reaches the target node via device-sync-hub and is available to the job.
